_comment: Engine routing: a role (what the pipeline needs) -> adapters (engines that can fill it). Scripts read this file through scripts/studio/engine_routing.py; a series overrides it with <series>/engines.json (merged per role and per adapter), and every script takes --engine <adapter> to pick a non-default one. Numbers under `measured` come from FRONTIER runs on one machine (RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB, Windows 11); treat them as examples to re-measure on yours, not as limits.
_how_to_add: To add an engine: add an adapter under its role with a `kind` the scripts already run, then set `default` or pass --engine. Kinds: `cli` (any command; `cmd` is an argv list whose {placeholders} the script fills, listed per role in `placeholders`; `output` says where the result is: `stdout`, `stdout-json` or `file` for {out}), `comfyui` (a ComfyUI API-format workflow in assets/comfyui-workflows/ that carries `_slots`; see generate-video-via-comfyui.py), `atlas-async` (a multix Atlas model run with upload, submit and fetch). A new kind is the only change that needs code. Record status (`chosen`, `rejected`, `untested`, `template`) and what you measured. Set `local: true` on an adapter that runs on this machine with no bill (`comfyui` is local already): only those may record cost_usd 0 in an engine A/B.

i2v-local.what: image-to-video on a local GPU: free per clip, slower, bounded by VRAM. Used for physical action inserts and retakes when the cash budget is tight.

minimax-h3-comfyui.notes: 4 s or more; snaps toward its end frame; MiniMaxH3AddGuide anchors an approved TTS take on the lips

ltx-2.5-comfyui.status: rejected by the user: acting and camera control below H3 (FRONTIER ep02 sc02)
ltx-2.5-comfyui.notes: about 3x faster than H3 on the same GPU; without an anime style LoRA on both stages the look is semi-realistic; the template's default encode (~2.8 Mbps) smeared small faces, so set crf before judging

i2v-cloud.what: image-to-video through a paid API: fast and parallel, billed per second or per clip. Routed per job by gen-plan.json `model` with prices in price-table.json (generate-media-via-multix.py), not by this table.

seedance-2.5.status: one sakuga shot per scene at most

seedance-2.0-mini-ref2v.status: chosen for blockout-guided action: cheapest ref2v, followed the keyframe's blocking as a reference image

refs._note: keys verified against the Atlas schema and a billed run 2026-10-26 (schema allows 9 images, 3 videos of 2-15 s, 15 s total). No first-frame field: `image` next to reference media is refused (HTTP 400), so the keyframe travels as a reference image

kling-v4.0-ref2v.status: alternative: most polished frames and a true first frame; 67% dearer than Seedance mini and drifted from the intent (ran at the drone instead of backing off)

refs._note: keys verified against the Atlas schema and a billed run 2026-10-26: `image` is the first frame and is @image_1, references number after it (image_tag_offset). Reference videos bill as input seconds; resolution defaults to 1080p, so set 720p; no seed field

tts.what: speech for every line. Routed per job by gen-plan.json (`tts` jobs and the character file's voice); takes are gated by gate-tts-takes.py, whichever provider made them.

gemini-flash-tts.status: chosen by the user's ear for FRONTIER

elevenlabs-v3.status: alternative; an AI judge preferred a clone the user rejected

fish-drama3-openrouter.status: candidate: better Vietnamese acting than Gemini 3.8 TTS by the user's ear, costs more; not the default until the FRONTIER benchmark and user approval
fish-drama3-openrouter.notes: billed per UTF-8 byte of directed_text (tags included); receipt has generation_id and cost_usd. See references/fish-drama3-voice-direction.md

fish-drama3-native.status: candidate; needs multix >= 1.22.0-beta (native Fish provider) and FISH_API_KEY
fish-drama3-native.notes: the response does not confirm the model that ran (model_confirmed false); voice design, cloning and pronunciation dictionaries are native only

asr.what: transcribe a take or a clip to diff it against the script.

seed-asr.status: template: untested here and cheapest per call; check the flags with `multix atlas audio --help` first

upscaler.what: 720p to 1080p of finished scene renders or trimmed clips; frame counts must match the source exactly.

byteplus-standard.notes: the professional tier cost 10x for a near-identical result

local-cli.status: template: replace cmd with a local upscaler (an ESRGAN-family CLI, a ComfyUI wrapper, ...)

ai-judge.what: a multimodal model that watches and listens to a short clip with the beat and the dialogue and returns JSON findings. A pointer to verify, never a verdict.

gemini-analyze.status: chosen; found a stray rustle, a stray yell and an unprocessed robot line, plus a clip-boundary false positive (FRONTIER ep02)

audio-aesthetic.what: a learned quality scorer for SFX and music assets (for example Audiobox Aesthetics: CE, CU, PC, PQ). A regression gate between versions of one asset only; it cannot tell whether a sound fits the shot.

audiobox-aesthetics.status: untested: researched for FRONTIER ep02, not run; fix cmd to the installed tool before use

sound-generation.what: SFX and Foley by capability. text-to-audio is the legacy ElevenLabs SFX path (a gen-plan `sfx` job with no `mode`). video-to-audio (`mode: video-to-audio`) hears the picture and writes synced Foley: fal endpoints through `multix fal`, never a fal client in this skill. `engine: auto` takes the first eligible adapter in `order` (capability, duration_s, license policy, not rejected). input_map is {model input: job field}; the result MP4 is reduced to a 48 kHz PCM WAV plus a sidecar. Output feeds only the hits or beds bus through a mix-add proposal. Prices measured and ear-reviewed on Windows 2026-10-26 (5 approved ep01 clips): the user picked Hunyuan on every clip, so `auto` tries it first; MMAudio is 10x cheaper and the fallback.

elevenlabs-sfx.status: chosen: the FRONTIER ep01-02 SFX path

mmaudio-v2-fal.status: fallback: 5 paid runs, $0.00100/s measured; good on big impacts and footsteps, misses fine multi-event Foley; lost every clip to Hunyuan by ear

license.note: fal model page lists licenseType commercial (read 2026-10-26); that covers the hosted endpoint only. The open MMAudio weights are CC BY-NC 4.0, so a local run is non-commercial

hunyuan-foley-fal.status: chosen by the user's ear: best on all 5 benchmark clips; $0.00996/s billed per real second (no 10 s minimum)

license.note: fal model page lists licenseType commercial (read 2026-10-26) for the hosted endpoint; the weights carry the Tencent Hunyuan community license (territory and scale limits) for local runs

audio-separation.what: split a mixed take into dialogue, effects and music stems (salvage a clip whose native audio has a usable hit, or strip music under a line). Runs as a gen-plan `isolate` job today; a stem adapter is a candidate only.

demucs-local.status: untested: fix cmd to the installed tool before use
